edition.title: NPNF Second Series, Volume XII: Leo the Great, Gregory the Great

alternate_titles: Leo the Great, Gregory the Great
work.author: Philip Schaff and Henry Wace
work.description: The twelfth volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Charles Lett Feltoe's translation of the letters and sermons of Leo the Great together with works of Gregory the Great. Its container identity remains distinct from the works and translated editions printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Volume XII
